comment: Inputs of the TMRKZ offline map package (ops/map-package/build_package.py). Paths are relative to the repository root; the large files are git-ignored under map-data/. Every input is checked against the checksum recorded here or in the terrain manifest before anything is packaged.

coverage.name: United Arab Emirates (mainland and islands)
coverage.basis: approximate extent of UAE territory, where Stationing sites and deployment areas lie; the basemap and the terrain grid must both cover it

basemap.obtainedFrom: byte-identical copy of MOVER's app/NavMap/data/uae.pmtiles (MOVER docs/OFFLINE_MAP_DATA_SOURCE_OF_TRUTH.md: PMTiles v3, Protomaps schema, OSM only)

fonts.covers: Arabic and its presentation forms, Latin, Arabic-Indic and European digits, brackets and guillemets

compatibility.terrainSchema: Flyway V18 or later (terrain_dataset, terrain_slope); loaded by ops/terrain/load-slope.sh
